periods.analysis: We trained 86 people in four sessions and launched the suicide prevention coalition with 11 organizations. Only four coalition partners represent higher-risk groups, and stigma messaging is still in early production, so the goal starts at Caution.
periods.recommendations: Recruit partners that serve veterans, LGBTQ+ youth and immigrant residents, and finish the first resident stories.

periods.analysis: Training is moving well, with 151 people trained and a large school staff session in May, and the coalition grew to 14 members. Representation is the gap: only six members serve higher-risk groups, and stigma messages have barely reached Seagrove and East Flats.
periods.recommendations: Keep training on pace with seaport and school transportation staff while pressing recruitment of higher-risk partners and translated messages.

periods.analysis: Training volume is strong, with 214 people trained in Q3 and a consistent 23-point knowledge gain, and the coalition has grown to 17 partners. Two gaps keep this goal at Caution: only 7 coalition partners serve higher-risk groups, and stigma messaging has not yet reached the Seagrove and East Flats audiences we promised. We will not call the goal on target until both close.
periods.recommendations: Close the higher-risk partner gap and take stigma messaging to East Flats and Seagrove.
